The '''Dresscol system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It had a [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] [[Star/Legends|star]], and was considered to be uninhabitable by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] over two hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It did contain the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Qetix IV]], which became the location of an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Qetix IV Alliance base|base]] that was a major [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] repair base.
